posts.text: In the last couple of weeks, I had the opportunity to attend the Canadian Tech Summit and the Canadian Undergraduate Conference on Artificial Intelligence (CUCAI) and present TruthLens, a project my team and I have been working on in the area of explainable AI and misinformation detection. TruthLens is an explainable AI framework designed to detect misinformation while also providing interpretable, evidence-grounded explanations for its predictions.
